item_name: Rothco Thin Red Line US Flag
item_short_desc: Show your support for firefighters with Rothco’s Thin Red Line US Flag, crafted from durable 100% polyester. Featuring a bold red stripe on a subdued black-and-white American flag, this design honors the bravery and sacrifices of firefighting professionals. Available in 2 sizes, this flag is perfect for both indoor and outdoor display, whether at home, in an office, or at a community event. Reinforced edges ensure lasting durability, and the lightweight material allows it to fly gracefully in the wind.
